newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO PLANS STEROL DEAL WITH FRENCH DRT.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO PLANS STEROL DEAL WITH FRENCH DRT.

text.p: Finnish foodstuffs, feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy said on Friday it planned to agree with French company DRT on an increase in DRT's production of sterols -- a key raw material for Raisio's Benecol margarine.
"Raisio intends to sign a contract with the French company Les Derives Resiniques et Terpeniques (DRT) for a substantial enlargement of DRT's production of sterols," Raisio said in a statement.
"The investment in the new production unit totals 50 million French francs of which 35 million francs will be a Raision loan to DRT," it said.
The new plant in Dax, southwestern France, would come on stream in 1999, it said.
"The new capacity is reserved for Raision," it said, adding the production co-operation agreement would complement Raision's European sterol supplies on a long term basis.
DRT has 40 years experience of sterol extraction, Raision said.
Raision needs sterol to make stanol ester for its cholesterol-reducing Benecol margarine.
"Raision's present stanol ester capacity is sufficient for current expansion plans in Europe," it said.

But Raision was also looking for opportunities North America. "Following encouraging business evaluation Raision has signed a pre-engineering study agreement with a well known international engineering company for a stanol ester plant to be built in USA. The first stage of the study will be finished this autumn," it said, but did not elaborate.
